MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper fits because I could use it to check nail and screw dimensions when matching fasteners for repairs.",
    "A measuring tool connects to my recent attention to different fastener lengths and sizes, giving it a clear purpose alongside those purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The relay harness, heat shrink tubing, wire connectors and test leads assume an electrical project that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "The cutting wheels and thermometer serve tasks I have no current reason to perform, even though they could belong in the same workshop.",
    "The pipe coupling requires a particular plumbing need and size match, while the bulk glue packs offer quantities and a fastening method I am not currently seeking."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying nails, screws and anchors seems to have been taken as interest in almost any repair or workshop supply.",
    "My purchases of large fastener packs seem to have been extended to bulk adhesives, although needing many screws does not mean I need many tubes of glue."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener purchases make dimensions, compatibility and the specific fastening task more relevant than a broad connection to tools.",
    "The vacuum bags show a specific replacement need; household maintenance purchases do not mean I have plumbing, wiring or metal-cutting work underway."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my repair-related shopping but stretched it into unrelated projects, with only the caliper offering a clear connection to my recent fastener purchases."
}
